summary: Backend testing for Quota co-parenting expense tracker. 19/19 pytest tests PASSED. Covered: health, auth (invalid session_id -> 401, missing token -> 401, valid seeded token -> 200), config (PUT/GET with parent1_email auto-filled from user), blocks CRUD (create, list, get, delete with 404 verify), expenses (add parent1 & parent2, update, delete), totals computation (total, quota_parent1, quota_parent2, paid_parent1, paid_parent2, saldo correctly computed = 71.06 for mixed payments), close_block with bonifico (status becomes 'closed', email sent to delivered@resend.dev + parent1_email successfully via Emergent email integration), closed-block mutation blocked (400), resend-email (parent1 only), max 24 blocks pruning (seeded 26 bulk blocks, after new POST list returns <=24), MongoDB serialization (no _id in user/config/block responses).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~710 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into auth/, blocks/, email/ modules in future iterations.
_compute_totals rounds saldo from unrounded quotas; the UI must use the backend 'saldo' field (not recompute from rounded quota_parent1/paid_parent1) to avoid 1-cent discrepancies.

Pruning uses sort by (year, month) only; two blocks in same month/year (shouldn't happen due to uniqueness check in create_block but no DB index enforces it) would be ambiguous. Consider adding a compound unique index on (user_id, year, month).
db.configs has no index on user_id (frequent lookups).
Email send failure raises 502 but close_block already mutated 'bonifico' into the in-memory blk dict before send; however, DB update only happens AFTER send succeeds, so DB state is consistent - OK.
seed_data_creation: Seeded user_test / test_token_123 (expires_at = now+7d) in db.users and db.user_sessions via motor fixture; also 26 bulk blocks for pruning test. All cleaned up in teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL from /app/frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. For protected endpoints seed db.user_sessions with a known session_token - no OAuth available. Email integration (Emergent) works with delivered@resend.dev; expect real send on close/resend. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_quota_backend.py is pytest-xdist-safe and idempotent.
